title: Signature Move
body:
Syntax: signature | signature <skill name> | signature clear

Choose any learned skill at 100% proficiency as your signature, including later-unlocked class techniques, bloodlines, sword schools, weapon skills, multi-attacks and passive abilities. Only one signature can be active. Train it from 100% to 150% by successful use, upkeep or passive combat participation; teacher practice cannot raise it past 100%. At 150%, supported effects gain 25% damage, effect strength or duration, including specific passive combat bonuses, not an uncapped activation chance. Switching or clearing resets the old signature to 100%. Normal skills remain capped at 100%.

Date: 2026-11-09
